title: Eddoboozi Nga Omuyaga Tegunnabaawo
intro: Omusajja mu ddungu yasituka okuyita eggwanga ery’amaanyi okudda mu mazima. Abantu baali bamanyiddwa olw’ebizimbe byabwe eby’ekitalo n’amaanyi gaabwe agataliiko kye gafaanana. Naye amalala gaabwe gaabaziba amaaso, ne bagaana okuwuliriza. Oluvannyuma, ekibonerezo eky’amaanyi kyabatuukako, ne bawonya ekibinja ekitono eky’abakkiriza.
clues: Nasindikibwa eri abantu ab’amaanyi abaali babeera mu nsi enzigule era nga bamanyiddwa olw’amaanyi gaabwe.
Abantu bange bajja nga bagoberera eggwanga eddala eddene eryazikirizibwa.
Baali balina ebizimbe ebirabika obulungi ennyo era nga bazimba eminaala emiwanvu.
Nabayita okusinza Katonda Omu, naye ne bagaana okusuula ebifaananyi byabwe.
Ekibonerezo eky’amaanyi kyabatuukako, ne basonyiwa abo bokka abakkiriza nange.
Nze eyasindikibwa eri abantu ab’amaanyi abamanyiddwa nga Aad.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Abantu bange baazikirizibwa empewo ey’amaanyi, so nga nze nnalokoka
Abantu bange baakubwa musisi ne bakaaba
Abantu bange baakubwa amayinja okuva mu bbanga
Abantu bange basuuliddwa mu muliro ogwaka

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
